title: Two in a row
brief: Two LEDs in series: the current goes through one, then the other. Same current, both lit.
Each green LED takes about 2.1 V, so two of them leave only about 0.8 V for the resistor. That's why this one is 150 Ω, not 330.
lesson: In series, every part carries the same current and the voltages add up: 5 V ≈ 0.8 V (resistor) + 2.1 V + 2.1 V. Turn on Probe view (V) and read it off the board.
